{"consolidated_memory":"Loss divergence in ml/train/loop.py — two separate incidents with different root causes:

**Incident 1 [2026-02-05]**
- Location: ml/train/loop.py, ml pipeline side
- Trigger: Affected only accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Signal: Loss curve turns upward and never returns
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #2157 on branch fix/loss-divergence-1
- Reproduction: Train two epochs on the small split
- Measured outcome: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 80 days running

**Incident 2 [2026-04-20]**
- Location: ml/train/loop.py, ml pipeline side (same context as earlier work)
- Trigger: Affected only payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Signal: Loss curve turns upward and never returns
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #8787 on branch fix/loss-divergence-2
- Reproduction: Train two epochs on the small split
- Measured outcome: Backlog cleared 55 minutes after the deploy

Both incidents share the same symptom (loss curve divergence) and same location (ml/train/loop.py) but had completely different triggers and required different fixes."}
